course_details.description: "The field of Entrepreneurship is increasingly important for India as evidenced by policy push for universities as also other sections of the society through the Startup India initiative. Popular research has identified that among various reasons for failure of new ventures, incorrect identification of customer need and problem statement is by far the most prevalent. This course will aid aspiring entrepreneurs (typically B Tech / MTech /PhD students) in deep understanding of customer needs and pain points thus eliminating the waste that occurs. For doctoral students, ethnographic enquiry is a well established methodology for theory building endeavours. With the field of entrepreneurship veering towards 302221entrepreneurship as practice302222 , a sociological approach to understanding this domain, field immersion techniques become crucial from academic research perspective. This methodology which forms the bedrock of theory building is particularly important at the time that India specific theories in the field of entrepreneurship are being sought to better promote new ventures in the economy.""1) Ethnography as a methodology for Innovation & entrepreneurship practice and research2) Gaining access to the field and ethics of ethnographic inquiry3) Participant and Non participant observations4) Forms of data - Visual data, historical data, videos and articles5) Data Collection - conducting Ethnographic interviews, shadowing the protagonists, artefacts6) Data Storage and organization7) Field notes and thick description8) Open and Axial Coding"

course_details.description: This course offers an introduction to the 1) impact of AI on startups and businesses, and 2) the emergence of new AI startups. Students will learn how AI is useful for businesses, and analyse the kind of functions and areas where AI may be applied. Students will learn how AI driven data feed into decision-making and more efficient processes. The course will also discuss how to think about the impact of AI implementation, and what leadership means in a rapidly changing AI-driven scenario. Students will learn about the pitfalls of AI including working with low-quality data, and ethical implications of Gen AI. In this course we will cover the following aspects: 1. Introduction to Gen AI and the AI landscape and why it is important for businesses to look at and understand AI. 2. Examples and use cases of how AI is applied in different business functions and sectors. How AI tools can be used in common business domains, functions and processes, how AI-driven data feeds into decision-making. We look at AI implementation examples in different business functions. 3. New business opportunities emerging out of AI and emerging AI first business. 4. Impact of AI on industries and sectors 5. Responsible AI: Ethics, Bias, Regulation 6. Role of leadership and change management: how to lead and manage AI-driven change.

course_details.description: FinTech is transforming how we access, use, and think about financial services. From digital payments and lending platforms to AI-driven investment tools and blockchain innovations, technology is creating new possibilities for disruption across the financial sector.This course offers a practical and accessible introduction to the world of FinTech, ideal for aspiring entrepreneurs, professionals, and curious learners alike.
